_notes: Pinned: the OpenFilm version is pinned in code (`PINNED_OPENFILM_VERSION` in miniapp/node/server.mjs, currently 0.3.0); the panel starts it by calling upstream's `startStudio` with `port: 0`, so the OS picks a free port — there is no configurable executable, argument list or port. flavor: which project list to show — release=~/.openfilm + ~/Movies/OpenFilm/Projects (default), dev=~/.openfilm-dev + ~/Movies/OpenFilm Dev/Projects. desktopMode: true = desktop interface (editor + chat + local agents), false = plain web Studio. openfilmRepo: local openfilm/openfilm clone needed for desktop mode (the desktop handlers are not published to npm), default ~/Developer/openfilm, or OPENFILM_REPO env; run `pnpm --filter @openfilm/desktop build:shell` there once. shellDist: built desktop page (default <repo>/apps/desktop/shell/dist). desktopApp: fixed auto-detection only (repo dev runtimes first, then /Applications/OpenFilm.app) — not configurable. studioHome: the panel's own Studio home; an override for an existing state directory (documented in ## Data & access). Machine-specific overrides belong in miniapp.config.local.json (gitignored).
